neighbours.label: The token ' welcome' / ' Welcome' (greeting or adjective), vs synonyms in the same slot
fire: Good evening and welcome to our annual charity dinner.
The rain was a welcome relief for the dry farms.
New members are always welcome at the chess club.
The teacher said a warm Welcome to the new pupils.
A hot meal was a welcome sight after the long hike.
Pets are welcome in all of our cabins.
Thank you and welcome to the first episode of the podcast.
Her kind words were a welcome surprise.
quiet: Good evening and thank you for coming to our annual charity dinner.
The rain was a great relief for the dry farms.
New members are always invited to the chess club.
The teacher said a warm hello to the new pupils.
A hot meal was a happy sight after the long hike.
Pets are allowed in all of our cabins.
Thank you for tuning in to the first episode of the podcast.
Her kind words were a pleasant surprise.

notes: Card: ' welcome' x18, ' Welcome' x9, 'Welcome' x5. Probe: 'a welcome change' 0.924, 'Hello and welcome' 0.858, 'is welcome to join' 0.771, 'welcomed' 0.351; greetings 0.095, pleasant 0.006, invited 0.075.
